thistlegorm.name: SS Thistlegorm
thistlegorm.remarks:
Bombed at anchor while carrying military stores.
Found and dived by Cousteau in the mid-fifties, and largely forgotten again until the nineties.

britannic.name: HMHS Britannic
britannic.remarks:
The third of her class, and the largest of the three.
Located and dived by Cousteau in 1975.
